message.reasoning_content: Sell 2 now: cash 34.5M. Next round cash floors to floor(34.5M/100)*62? Wait cash units: floor(34555000/100)*62 = 345550*62=21.4M. Sell credit gives 27.5M promissory added next round. Devaluation punishes cash. sell_credit 2: promissory 27.5M added in round 6 (final round start), then final market... but last round promissory not repaid? Wait promissory added at start of round 6, but last market already happened in round 6? Order: round 6 start cash=floor/100*62, promissory added. Then round 6 market can... promissory is cash, but final rank counts cash. But "after last round promissory not repaid" — sell_credit in last round gives nothing. Round 6 market: sell_credit useless. So sell credit now: 27.5M cash arrives round 6 start, avoiding devaluation of 34.5M? No — cash also devalued. sell_credit 2: cash stays 12.5M (devalues to ~7.7M), promissory 27.5M becomes cash round 6, total ~35.2M at end plus final market sales. sell cash: 34.5M devalues to 21.4M. Clearly sell_credit better. Choice 4.
